name: edututor
description: EduTutor — O'zbekiston uchun onlayn repetitorlik platformasi

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,blue "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.render:build: npm install --include=dev && npm run build && npm run db:deploy --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
